parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols cfm mode standard.explanation: 配置CFM（Connectivity Fault Management）模式为标准模式。

set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1.command: set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1
set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1.explanation: 在指定的维护域下配置维护端点（Maintenance End Point）。

set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 remote-.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] mep [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3]
set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 remote-.command: set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 remote-mep 3

set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 ccm-rec.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] mep [parameter2] ccm-receive mep-id [parameter3] interval [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 ccm-rec.command: set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 ccm-receive mep-id 3 interval 10
set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 ccm-rec.explanation: 配置接收CCM（Continuity Check Message）的MEP ID和间隔时间。

set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 ccm-rec.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] mep [parameter2] ccm-receive mep-id [parameter3]
set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 ccm-rec.command: set protocols cfm md md1 mep ma1 ccm-receive mep-id 3

set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 cr.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] mep mep-id [parameter2] crosscheck mep-id [parameter3] interface [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 cr.command: set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 crosscheck mep-id 3 interface ge-0/0/1
set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 cr.explanation: 配置MEP的交叉检查，指定检查的MEP ID和接口。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 进行交叉检查的接口名称。

set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 cc.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] mep mep-id [parameter2] ccm-send mep-id [parameter3] interval [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 cc.command: set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 ccm-send mep-id 4 interval 10
set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 cc.explanation: 配置发送CCM的MEP ID和间隔时间。

set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 cc.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] mep mep-id [parameter2] ccm-send mep-id [parameter3]
set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 cc.command: set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 ccm-send mep-id 4

set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 lo.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] mep mep-id [parameter2] loss-measurement single-ended receive test-id [parameter3]
set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 lo.command: set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 loss-measurement single-ended receive test-id 2
set protocols cfm md md1 mep mep-id 4 lo.explanation: 配置单端丢失测量的接收测试ID。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members vlan2
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换VLAN成员。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
